p3-acct-balance.actual: BUG: journals were unbalanced whenever a pay line had after-tax deductions (dedM, advance/loan recoveries): netM = gross - PAYE - eeNi - eePen - dedM but the 6-line journal credited only PAYE/NIC + pension + net, so credits fell short by sum(dedM) (Xero/Sage/QBO reject or, worse, accept a lopsided draft). Fixed with an optional 7th 'Other deductions' credit bucket derived per line in integer pence (required only when non-zero). All totals now use integer pence, so 200 staff / odd pence / float noise / huge lines (<=10M) balance exactly.
p3-acct-balance.evidence: server/src/lib/accounting.ts (computeTotals, journalLegs, requiredBuckets); server/src/lib/accounting.selftest.ts 75/75; e2e/accounting-edge.spec.ts S1 (live Xero+QBO fetch-back: legs equal computeTotals and net to 0); e2e/payroll-run-size.spec.ts (200 staff)

p3-acct-negative-zero.actual: Negative totals (correction/reversal) used to emit negative Amounts (QBO rejects) and zero lines were sent (QBO/Sage reject). Builders now flip Debit/Credit and drop zero legs. NOTE: POST /api/payroll/runs now refuses negative figures, so a reversal run is only reachable by writing the draft doc directly (spec does this); there is no product path for a correction run yet.
p3-acct-negative-zero.evidence: accounting.selftest.ts; accounting-edge.spec.ts S3 live on both providers

p3-acct-refs.actual: DocNumber was AOS-PAYROLL-YYYY-MM, identical for every run in a month (weekly/off-cycle/correction) and blank-date runs produced 0000-00. Now AOS-PAY-YYMM-<6 hex of the run key> (19 chars, QBO limit 21); Sage ref PAYROLL-YYYY-MM-<6hex> (22, limit 30); missing/invalid paidOn is a 400. QBO fetch-back proves two same-month runs get different DocNumbers and a DocNumber query returns exactly one journal.

p3-acct-double-post-race.actual: BUG: no lock between the 'already posted?' read and the provider call, and the catch block overwrote accounting with status failed even if a concurrent request had just posted (wiping the posted state -> next click double-posts). Fixed: Firestore-transaction claim (status 'posting', claimToken, 3-min TTL), losers wait for the winner and return alreadyPosted; failure write only while still holding the claim and never over 'posted'. A run posted to provider A is refused (409) for provider B instead of overwriting the live journal id. Live: 4x Promise.all posts -> four 200s, one journal id, exactly one non-alreadyPosted; QBO DocNumber query returns exactly one entry.

p3-acct-xero-idempotency-key-reuse.actual: BUG (found by direct probe of the Xero test org): re-using an Idempotency-Key with a DIFFERENT body returns 400. The key was runId:tenant only, so after a failed post and a mapping fix the retry could never succeed on Xero. Key now includes a fingerprint of the request body (identical retries still dedupe; corrected payload gets a fresh key).
p3-acct-xero-idempotency-key-reuse.evidence: bodyFingerprint(); accounting-edge.spec.ts S5 retry-after-fix live on Xero

p3-acct-xero-silent-blank-account.actual: BUG (probe): Xero accepts a DRAFT manual journal whose AccountCode is unknown/archived OR a system account (800 Accounts Payable, 801 Unpaid Expense Claims, 820 VAT, 860 Rounding, 877 Tracking Transfers...) with 200 and silently BLANKS the code; it only fails when someone posts it ('Account code or ID must be specified'). The old live spec passed against such journals (it mapped 860/877). Fixes: response is read back and a blanked line -> the draft is deleted and a 422 validation error is returned; the accounts dropdown no longer offers system/AR/AP accounts; PUT mapping refuses them.
p3-acct-xero-silent-blank-account.evidence: xeroPostJournal read-back; loadAccounts groups; accounting-edge.spec.ts S5/S5b (Xero)

p3-acct-mapping-validation.actual: PUT /mapping accepted anything. Now when the provider is connected each id is checked against the live chart (exists+active, right kind: expense for the 3 debit buckets, liability for PAYE/NIC + pension, bank/liability for net pay, AR/AP and Xero system accounts refused) with a per-bucket message; if the provider is unreachable it saves with validated:false. Also PUT used a deep merge so a cleared dropdown could never actually clear a bucket: now replaces the mapping. Xero account list restricted to Status ACTIVE.

p3-acct-token-failure.actual: Dead refresh token / expired access token used to surface as a generic 502 with the raw provider body ('Xero token exchange failed: HTTP 400 {...}'). Now: ProviderError kind auth -> 409 'X needs to be reconnected...', connection flagged needsReconnect (shown on the Accounting card), run stored failed/errorKind auth; nothing sensitive echoed. A 401 with a still-'valid' access token (revoked/rotated) triggers ONE forced refresh + retry transparently. Concurrent refreshes for one connection are single-flighted (a second request no longer burns the already-rotated Xero/Sage refresh token and looks disconnected). Verified live by temporarily corrupting then byte-exactly restoring the stored tokens (helpers/connTokens.ts).

p3-acct-retries-timeouts.actual: No fetch had a timeout, retry or 429 handling. Added pfetch: 20s timeout; up to 3 attempts; 429 honours Retry-After (cap 8s); 502/503/504/timeouts retried only where replay is safe (GETs, QBO requestid POST, Xero Idempotency-Key POST). Token POSTs and Sage journal POST are never replayed after a timeout/5xx (rotating refresh token / no documented idempotency). Route maps rate->429+Retry-After, validation->422, outage->502, timeout->504, and stores status failed + errorKind + message on the run. Live 429/5xx cannot be induced against the vendors; covered by selftest with stubbed fetch.

p3-acct-provider-reject.actual: Provider-side rejection (unknown account smuggled past validation) -> 422 kind validation; run.accounting stored as failed with errorKind and message; no journalId; retry after fixing the mapping posts once and stores posted.

p3-acct-currency.actual: Xero org base currency GBP (fine). QBO sandbox home currency USD, multicurrency off: the journal posts WITHOUT error, GBP figures silently land as US dollars. Nothing in our request carries a currency, so a non-GBP company file is never detected. PROPOSED FIX: pre-flight before the first post (cache on the connection): Xero GET /Organisation BaseCurrency; QBO GET /preferences CurrencyPrefs.HomeCurrency; refuse with 409 'connected company is in USD, ActivityOS payroll is GBP' unless base==GBP (allow an env override such as ACCOUNTING_ALLOW_NON_GBP for the sandbox e2e). Not implemented because it would fail the standing QBO sandbox spec.

p3-acct-period-locks.actual: Journal date = run.paidOn (runs are immutable after approval, so there is no re-open/period-change path). A provider lock date / closed period (Xero lock date, QBO closing date) comes back as a 4xx and is stored as failed/validation with the provider's wording; not exercised live (would require editing the test orgs' settings). A pay period straddling two months is journalled wholly on paidOn.

p3-sage.actual: Sage not connected: post gives 409 'Sage isn't connected' after mapping/approval gates (never reaches the vendor); sageJournalBody unit-tested for debit==credit, no zero/zero lines, sign flipping. Sage journal POST is never auto-retried after timeout/5xx.

p3-payslip-taxyear.actual: BUG: payslipPdf.taxYearFor treated every date from 1 April as the new tax year, so a payslip dated 1-5 April showed the wrong year and wrong YTD window, disagreeing with payrollYtd.ukTaxYearOf (6 April). Tax month also now counts from the 6th.

p3-run-size.actual: 200-person realistic run accepted/approved and balances. BUG: an oversized run (1000 lines with extra fields, passthrough schema) blew Firestore's 1 MiB doc limit inside .create() and returned a bare 500. Now a 413 with advice to split (limit 900 KB). Note: this edit is in server/src/routes/payroll.ts, which another agent also has uncommitted changes in, so it was left uncommitted in the tree.

p3-approve-race.actual: The approve double-count race I intended to flag (concurrent approve -> YTD added twice) was already fixed by another agent (transaction + createdByUid check) while I worked; the existing xero/qbo specs had to be updated to patch createdByUid as well.

p3-exports-fps-p60.actual: NOT BUILT / cannot be produced correctly today: (1) No pension-provider export exists at all (no NI number, DOB, address, pensionable-pay or contribution-date columns; NI numbers are only in payrollConfig, encrypted, not on run lines). (2) The only export is a client-side CSV of the on-screen draft lines: no run id, paid-on date, employee id or NI number; formula-injection-safe via lib/csv. (3) No FPS/RTI data set: missing NI earnings bands (LEL/PT/UEL), taxable-pay-to-date, starter declaration, week1/month1, irregular-payment and hours-band flags, student-loan, employee DOB/gender/address, employer PAYE/Accounts Office refs. payrollYtd stores taxable = gross (documented approximation) and no NIC-band figures. (4) No P60/P45 generator: only the payrollYtd store (gross/paye/NI/pension/net per tax year, updated at approval). If the YTD update throws after approval it is only logged and never retried, so an approved run can permanently miss the YTD store: needs an applied marker + reconcile job. All pay figures are labelled estimates; RTI stays with a real payroll provider. Nothing was submitted to HMRC.
